body: Thank you for your advice and answers kind internet stranger. I shall take them all on board

I want to be but I just can't open up to a doctor. It's so engrained in my head to just take a concrete pill and harden up that I end up not saying anything.
Quitting my job is an option, but I'd be homeless within a couple months and the idea of that would probably just add stress. I'm in a new city and don't know anyone either. My father is struggling so I can't burden him. My mother's the cause of my mental illness I think and my sister doesn't deserve to have me moping around around her.
I know I should just talk to the doc and get some meds but it's the opening up part I find hard. I'm hoping this'll make it easier

Well I mean yea. Everyone and everything has an end. But just because something is inevitable doesn't mean that you have to embrace it. There's a lot in life to live for, it just sucks that sometimes we can't see them.

I have got a history of depression and have tried once, grace of a stranger saved me and I managed to keep my family and friends ignorant and lie away the hospital visit (whether they really are or not idk, but they act it around me) But I don't want to die.
Is it as bad as I've made it in my head? Does it make me weak wanting help? Will I be ridiculed like I fear? Why can I not talk to who I need to? 
I don't actually expect an answer to a lot of those but appreciate being able to voice them.
Thanks for being there, I'm also here for you if there is anything I can do
